text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This day's finally freakin' here!
Kept me waiting way too long, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I put on a pathetic showing in my last race,
so I've been waiting for the chance to redeem myself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm not makin' the same mistake twice!
Well then, I'm off to go pick a fight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This time I'll make a magnificent flower bloom on the grand stage, so count on it!
